work.author: Alexander Schmidt
work.description: The standard nineteenth-century concordance-dictionary to Shakespeare's vocabulary. Volume II covers M-Z and was searched in this run for a gloss on "world without end"; it carries none.
work.title: Shakespeare-Lexicon: A Complete Dictionary of All the English Words, Phrases and Constructions in the Works of the Poet
